title: Assam govt signs MoUs with 6 organisations for introducing AI in school education
description: Assam's education minister announced a significant collaboration with six organizations. These partnerships aim to integrate Artificial Intelligence into the state's school education system. Google AI will focus on teacher training and digital skills development.
